g.title: Embeds the query once with the search_query prefix, then asks the vector store and the BM25 index for 20 candidates each.
Returns the 20 chunks nearest the query vector, using the HNSW graph when its snapshot is current and an exact cosine scan otherwise, including below 1,000 records.
Returns the 20 best keyword matches. The lenient query parser means code-shaped input such as foo::bar() never fails to parse.
query.rs merges the two ranked lists with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, keyed by file and start line, and prints the top five chunks with file, line range and code.
